description: This file defines conversion functions for handling string slices and primitive types, as well as a key mapping function and a specific conversion for metav1 field selectors, within the Kubernetes runtime package.

methods.name: DefaultMetaV1FieldSelectorConversion
methods.description: Converts label-value pairs for 'metadata.name' and 'metadata.namespace' to standardized forms, returning errors for unknown labels.

methods.name: JSONKeyMapper
methods.description: Determines JSON key names based on struct tags for mapping between map and struct representations.

methods.name: RegisterStringConversions
methods.description: Registers conversion functions for string slices to other primitive types within a conversion scheme.
